map.由贷款额与抵押物价值求 LTV: Loan-to-Value from Loan Amount and Collateral Value
map.输入贷款额与抵押物评估价值，求贷款价值比。: Enter the loan amount and the collateral's appraised value to find the loan-to-value ratio.
map.📖 查看「由贷款额与抵押物价值求 LTV 使用指南」: View "Loan-to-Value from Loan Amount and Collateral Value User Guide"
map.LTV=贷款额÷抵押物评估值。分母通常取评估值与成交价的较低者以防「高评高贷」，: LTV = loan amount ÷ collateral appraised value. The denominator usually takes the lower of appraised value and transaction price to prevent 'over-appraisal lending'; a lower LTV means safer leverage and stronger resistance to negative equity when prices fall.
map.LTV 越低风险越小。: The lower the LTV, the lower the risk.
map.申请按揭时评估抵押率是否达标。: Assess whether the mortgage pledge ratio meets the threshold when applying.
map.银行风控设定 LTV 上限控制敞口。: Banks set LTV caps in risk control to limit exposure.
map.二押、加按前核算可贷空间。: Estimate the lendable headroom before a second charge or top-up.
map.贷款 200 万、房产评估值 300 万的 LTV: LTV for a 2,000,000 loan and 3,000,000 property appraisal
map.LTV=贷款额÷抵押物价值=200÷300=66.7%。低于多数住宅 70% 的: LTV = loan amount ÷ collateral value = 200 ÷ 300 = 66.7%. Below the 70% first-home cap for most residences, so there is still lendable headroom.
map.LTV 越低越好吗？: Is a lower LTV always better?
map.对银行是风险越低越好；对借款人 LTV 越低意味着首付越多、杠杆越小。高 LTV: For the bank, lower risk is better; for the borrower, lower LTV means a larger down payment and smaller leverage. High LTV gives high leverage but weak downside protection, and prices falling easily create 'negative equity'.
map.评估值和成交价哪个作分母？: Which is the denominator, appraised value or transaction price?
map.银行通常用「评估值」而非成交价（取较低者），以防范高评高贷。评估值低于成交价时: Banks usually use the 'appraised value' rather than the transaction price (taking the lower one) to guard against over-appraisal lending. When the appraisal is below the transaction price, the LTV runs high.
